controls.label: Waveform
controls.tooltip: Sine is purest, saw is buzziest and brightest, square is hollow.

controls.label: Octave
controls.tooltip: Higher is a higher register; negative values go toward bass and sub territory.

controls.label: Semitone
controls.tooltip: Higher shifts pitch up in semitone steps; +7 is a fifth, +12 an octave.

controls.label: Fine
controls.tooltip: Further from zero drifts the pitch and creates slow beating against oscillator A.

controls.label: Level
controls.tooltip: Higher is louder; zero turns oscillator B off.

controls.label: Pan
controls.tooltip: Negative is left, positive is right, zero is center.

controls.label: Unison
controls.tooltip: More voices is thicker and bigger; 1 is a single plain voice.

controls.label: Detune
controls.tooltip: Higher spreads the unison voices further apart, sounding wider and lusher; too high sounds out of tune.

controls.label: Noise
controls.tooltip: Higher mixes white noise in with the oscillators for air, breath, and texture; zero is none.

controls.label: Glide
controls.tooltip: Higher makes the pitch slide slowly from the previous note into each new one; at the minimum every note starts exactly on pitch.

controls.label: Type
controls.tooltip: Lowpass removes highs (darker), highpass removes lows (thinner), bandpass keeps only the middle (nasal, telephone-like).

controls.label: Cutoff
controls.tooltip: Higher is brighter and more open; lower is darker and more muffled.

controls.label: Resonance
controls.tooltip: Higher emphasizes the cutoff frequency, from subtle sharpening to a squelchy acid whistle.

controls.label: Env Amount
controls.tooltip: Further from zero makes the filter envelope sweep the cutoff more; positive opens then closes (plucky), negative closes then opens.

controls.label: Keytrack
controls.tooltip: Higher makes high notes open the filter more, keeping brightness consistent up the keyboard.

controls.label: Drive
controls.tooltip: Higher saturates the signal inside the filter, adding warmth at low settings and grit and bite when pushed hard.

controls.label: Slope
controls.tooltip: 24 cuts everything above the cutoff harder (darker, more synthetic); 12 rolls off gently, leaving the top end airier and more open.

controls.label: Attack
controls.tooltip: Higher fades the note in slowly (pads, swells); lower snaps instantly (plucks, keys, punch).

controls.label: Decay
controls.tooltip: Lower falls to the sustain level faster, sounding more percussive and plucky.

controls.label: Sustain
controls.tooltip: Higher holds the note at a louder level while the key is down; zero makes every note die away like a pluck.

controls.label: Release
controls.tooltip: Higher lets the note ring out after the key is released; lower cuts it off quickly.

controls.label: Velocity
controls.tooltip: Higher makes how hard a key is hit change the loudness more (expressive, dynamic); zero plays every note at the same level.

controls.label: Attack
controls.tooltip: Higher makes the filter open gradually after the note starts.

controls.label: Decay
controls.tooltip: Lower makes the filter sweep close quickly, giving a short plucky bite.

controls.label: Sustain
controls.tooltip: Higher keeps the filter more open while the key is held.

controls.label: Release
controls.tooltip: Higher lets the filter close slowly after the key is released.

controls.label: Waveform
controls.tooltip: Sine and triangle wobble smoothly, square chops on and off, sample and hold jumps randomly.

controls.label: Rate
controls.tooltip: Higher wobbles faster; very low is a slow drift, very high is a nervous flutter.

controls.label: Depth
controls.tooltip: Higher is more movement; zero is completely still.

controls.label: Target
controls.tooltip: Cutoff gives wah and wobble, pitch gives vibrato, amp gives tremolo, pan sweeps side to side.

controls.label: Fade In
controls.tooltip: Higher makes the LFO movement fade in gradually after each note starts, like a singer adding vibrato late; zero starts the movement immediately.

controls.label: Retrigger
controls.tooltip: Note restarts the wobble at the start of every note so each attack moves identically; free lets one wobble run continuously underneath all notes.

controls.label: Drive
controls.tooltip: Higher pushes the sound harder into the distortion, from mild crunch to full fuzz; only audible once distortion mix is turned up.

controls.label: Mix
controls.tooltip: Higher blends in more of the distorted signal for grit and aggression; zero is completely clean.

controls.label: Rate
controls.tooltip: Higher makes the chorus swirl faster; slow rates sound lush and dreamy, fast rates sound watery.

controls.label: Depth
controls.tooltip: Higher sweeps the chorus pitch further for a deeper, lusher, more detuned shimmer.

controls.label: Mix
controls.tooltip: Higher blends in more chorus, sounding wider, lusher, and shimmering; zero is off.

controls.label: Time
controls.tooltip: Higher spaces the echoes further apart; very short times give a tight slapback, long times give spacious repeats.

controls.label: Feedback
controls.tooltip: Higher makes each echo repeat more times before dying away.

controls.label: Mix
controls.tooltip: Higher blends in more echo; zero is off.

controls.label: Size
controls.tooltip: Higher sounds like a bigger space, from a small room up to a huge hall.

controls.label: Decay
controls.tooltip: Higher lets the reverb tail ring out longer after each note.

controls.label: Mix
controls.tooltip: Higher blends in more reverb, sounding wetter, more spacious, and more distant; zero is completely dry.

controls.label: Volume
controls.tooltip: Higher is louder overall.

controls.label: Width
controls.tooltip: Higher is wider; 1 leaves the stereo image unchanged, 0 collapses it to mono, 2 exaggerates the sides.
